caption: The drawing depicts a single cylindrical mug positioned centrally on a plain background. The mug is rendered in grayscale, showing a metallic texture with shading that gives it a three-dimensional appearance. The body of the mug is smooth with two horizontal bands near the top and bottom. The base is slightly wider than the body, and the rim is also slightly flared. Attached to the right side of the mug is an ornate handle with curved and scrolling elements. The drawing is contained within a square border set against a light beige background, and there is a small artist’s signature, “A. ZAIDENBERG,” in the lower right corner inside the square.
title: Pewter Mug
